entities.summary: Mare Mikoff is an Estonian sculptor, best known for her sculptures of Jüri Vilms and Paul Keres in Pärnu, of Karl Menning at the Vanemuine in Tartu, and public sculptures in Nõmme and at the Viru Keskus. Influenced by hyperrealism and pop art, her work has been exhibited at the Museum of Estonian Architecture.
